latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of coo-onboarding-coach, providing structured guidance for new Chief Operating Officers.

- Guides newly-hired or promoted COOs, VP Operations, and "Number 2" leaders through their first 90 days and ongoing strategic decisions.
- Offers comprehensive diagnostic intake to clarify role, scope, and CEO relationship.
- Covers common COO archetypes and failure modes to avoid misalignment.
- Provides frameworks for CEO-COO contract, stakeholder mapping, scorecard design, and organizational assessment.
- Supports onboarding for full-time and fractional COOs across multiple company stages and CEO types.
